Island_084.terrain_character: Sheltered mountain-basin homeland with forested slopes and room for an interior lake; outer ridges should form a protective bowl with only a few natural passes.
Island_084.settlement_role: Peaceful village heartland; inward-facing settlements clustered around the lake and sheltered valleys rather than major through-routes.
Island_084.secondary_feature: Interior lake, forested mountain ring, limited pass access
Island_084.travel_role: Secondary destination connected to the Crownlands through a small number of deliberate mountain passes, not a major trade crossroads.
Island_084.lore_notes: A naturally defensible settled basin whose geography encouraged a quieter, close-knit culture distinct from the political core and the grand alpine High Kingdom.
